apparatus.note: The printed margin reads “Gr. Jesus” for the proper name translated Joshua in the main text; compare Acts 7:45. This translation note is distinct from the running verse.
The original 1901 print gives the alternative “Or, censer.” It is not substituted into the main text.
The printed apparatus notes a reading in many ancient authorities beginning “ye have your own selves for a better possession.” It is not inserted in the main text.
Original printed notes document alternative readings “work” and “you” in ancient authorities. The facsimile retains the complete marginal notes.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
